findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: getting_here, tap_water, urgent_care, benefit_galas · Private data: plan_my_day, search_places, upcoming_events, recently_closed, where_to_stay, getting_here, things_to_do, community_help, golden_hour, play_sport, tap_water, urgent_care, benefit_galas · Public sink: whats_open_now, where_to_stay, getting_here, picnic_spots · Destructive: getting_here, work_out, play_sport.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: getting_here, tap_water, urgent_care, benefit_galas · Private data: plan_my_day, search_places, upcoming_events, recently_closed, where_to_stay, getting_here, things_to_do, community_help, golden_hour, play_sport, tap_water, urgent_care, benefit_galas · Public sink: whats_open_now, where_to_stay, getting_here, picnic_spots · Destructive: getting_here, work_out, play_sport

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
